build_vocab_and_binarize: build vocabularies and binarize training data for a source-target language pair using fairseq preprocess
build_dictionary: build a source or target dictionary from training text files with configurable word threshold and nwords
binarize_dataset: binarize text data into indexed dataset files using a vocabulary with multiprocessing support
binarize_alignments: binarize word alignment files into indexed dataset format for use during training
compute_alignment_dict: compute the most frequent source-target token alignment pairs from an alignment file and save them
